project_akantilado_short_desc: Solo sound designer on a student 3D animation. Two cats chasing a golden orb through a jungle. I built a 5-layer ambience, synced all foley frame-by-frame, and delivered both a stereo and 5.1 surround mix.
project_amorak_short_desc: Horror animation. The creature roar is 4 animal layers (lion, elephant, tiger, hippo) pitched down for weight. I mixed the whole soundscape in binaural 3D.
project_audioq_short_desc: Sampler plugin I built in JUCE (C++). Granular synthesis, hand-coded tremolo DSP, TPT zero-delay filters, built-in compressor. VST3 and AU. Open source.
project_gradwork_short_desc: Bachelor thesis: tested 3 AI audio models for real-time game use. None were fast enough, so I built a predictive caching system that serves pre-generated sounds in under 55ms.
project_middleware-optimization_short_de: Three Wwise school projects where I hit real walls: 256 voices blew up a zombie shooter, zone transitions popped in a platformer, and a 2GB Android phone told me my audio was too big.
project_not_today_darling_short_desc: Only audio person on a 6-person student team. 4-player shared-screen racer where grandmas fight for inheritance. I built a MetaSounds engine system, recorded all the sounds, and we voiced the grandmas ourselves. Fixed the mix so UI feedback survives 4 players crashing at once.
project_pause_and_deserve_short_desc: Horror game where pausing the game freezes time, but the enemy gets faster when you unpause. Audio reacts to how long you hesitate.
project_pawism_short_desc: 48-hour game jam, solo audio. UI clicks, ambient tension loops, Wwise implementation. Everything built under pressure. Fast iteration, hard priorities.
project_ray_animation_short_desc: Disco-funk score for a graduation film. Original composer dropped out with 8 days left. I wrote and delivered the track in time for the cinema screening.
project_richter_short_desc: Student earthquake film, no commercial libraries allowed. Walked around with a Zoom H6 recording every surface I could find. Built drones in Vital, wrote a short orchestral cue. The quake rumble kept eating the dialogue, so the mix took a full day of EQ automation.
project_shadow_frames_short_desc: Audio designer on a multi-school horror game (Wwise + UE5.5 + C++). Sound is the only way to find anomalies. I built the footstep system, enemy proximity audio, and 3-stage anomaly detection.
project_sound-design_short_desc: I muted the original audio and rebuilt it. God of War axe impacts from metal-on-meat recordings. Baldur's Gate spells from pitched-down gas burners and granular synthesis. A realistic pistol vs. a sci-fi weapon that sounds like electricity through glass.
project_transientica_audiolab_short_desc: Rhythm game you control with your voice. Real-time beatbox recognition, under 60ms latency, 92% accuracy.
project_unreal_engine_rebuilder_short_de: One click: cleans Intermediate/Saved, regenerates project files, recompiles from scratch. Fixes linker errors that would take 15 minutes to sort out manually.
project_wwise_unreal_fixer_short_desc: Fixes broken Wwise references in Unreal after Perforce pulls or migrations. One click, all silent actors come back. Saves hours of manual file editing.
